name: Survey the Old Access Road
objective: Inspect road marker and transmission trace
briefing: Survey the old access road and confirm the transmission trace. CentroCom maps show the route as "passable", a term last reviewed before the road was.

encounter.title: A blocked service lane
encounter.text: Halfway along the road a collapsed sign gantry blocks the service lane. A drainage culvert runs beside it: narrow, damp, and already somebody else's idea.

choices.label: Clear the service lane
choices.detail: +2 hours. Recover 10 Scrap Metal from the gantry.
choices.result: The team cuts the gantry apart and drags it clear. The lane is open, the scrap is coming home, and everyone is two hours more tired.

choices.label: Use the drainage path
choices.result: The team squeezes through the culvert. Nobody discusses what they stepped in. The survey continues on schedule.

report: Access survey complete. The road marker is a relay maintenance beacon. Two sites added to Regional Intelligence: a service depot showing recent human activity, and the regional relay station.

name: The Maintenance Crew
objective: Contact two survivors sheltering at service depot
briefing: Two maintenance workers have been sheltering at the service depot. Make contact. CentroCom reminds you that rescued personnel are not pre-approved for housing.

encounter.title: People behind the door
encounter.text: The depot door opens a hand's width. Two maintenance workers, thin but steady, look past your team at the road. "We have the relay keycard," one says. "We also have questions about your food."

choices.label: Offer a place at the outpost
choices.detail: Creates 2 recruit candidates. They still need beds and Food.
choices.result: They pack in four minutes; they have been ready for weeks. Their candidate cards are waiting on the Recruitment screen.

choices.label: Deliver aid and exchange information
choices.detail: Uses 1 First Aid Kit. Gain 20 Food. They stay as safe contacts.
choices.result: The kit changes hands, then a crate of tinned food comes back the other way. They will stay put for now, and they know where to find you.

report: Contact established with the maintenance crew. Relay keycard recovered.

name: Restore the Regional Relay
objective: Secure portable battery and relay diagram
briefing: Recover the relay battery and wiring diagram. The station has been "temporarily resting" for three years. Please do not wake anything else.

encounter.title: The lower door
encounter.text: The battery sits in a cage below the transmitter. The lower door hangs on one hinge, and the ceiling above it has been thinking about falling for some time.

choices.label: Secure the door and follow the diagram
choices.result: The team props the ceiling, unbolts the cage by the book and carries the battery out. Slow, careful and completely uneventful. CentroCom considers this ideal.

choices.label: Recover the battery and withdraw
choices.detail: No delay. One member takes 10 damage (5 with a First Aid Kit).
choices.result: The battery comes free; so does part of the ceiling. One of the team limps out swearing, battery in hand.

report: Relay battery and wiring diagram recovered. Radio Relay blueprint authorized. 6 Components salvaged from the station.
